meta.frame: each root in its own frame: z up, the front -y, origin on the ground under its middle (the cave: the floor in its mouth); the ice roots in their host prefab's frame. Every pivot / pos here is in its root's frame. In world.blend the roots stand apart (display_offset); their FBX is exported with the root at the origin
meta.unity: position (x, y, z) -> Unity (-x, z, -y) in the prefab; axis likewise; angle -> -angle (Unity is left-handed); box centre likewise, size (sx, sy, sz) -> (sx, sz, sy); the root's front (-y) is the prefab's +Z
meta.colliders: BoxCollider per type box entry on its parent (center / size in the parent's own frame); type hit: a trigger box of a removable ice part; type mesh: the cave's MeshCollider (object COLM_Cave). The COL_ / HIT_ objects are in the .blend for reference (collection Colliders), not in the FBX

warm_radius.note: burning: no wind-chill and R1 (creatures keep off) within 3.5 m; embers: 1.5 m

meta.lights: world_lights.json: the barrel's fire and the four candles in the cave (all off in the file)
meta.ice: each ice root goes under its host (forest_far RelayMast / Dish_n, forest_main BaseMain) at the origin; the root is scenery (show after a blizzard, hide when it thaws); the removable parts are what the players knock off to get the aerial working again (QUESTIONS_HORROR 41, BASE_THREATS B04); M_World_Ice is box-mapped (UV 1 = 1 m, the texture repeats)
meta.materials: M_World_World / M_World_Cave: baked PSX atlases (point filter); M_World_Panel: the station marking on the shift car's doors and the 1991 newspaper; M_World_Glass: the cars' windows; M_World_GlassCracked: the wreck's windscreen (alpha); M_World_Fire: the flames, 8-frame flipbook, alpha cut-out, emissive; M_World_Embers_Off / M_World_Embers: the barrel's ember bed and air holes cold / glowing (off in the file); M_World_Ice: the ice overlays
meta.names: FireBarrel, ShiftCar, WreckCar and ForesterCave are fixtures (not carried); the doors IX_* without numbers - Unity numbers them when it places them
